guidance.statement: Management expects revenue growth of around 8% to 10% for the year.
guidance.quote: the guidance at present level is 8%. Around 8% to 10%

guidance.statement: Management expects to maintain operating EBITDA margin at around 31%.
guidance.quote: we will be maintaining 31% at operating level

guidance.statement: Management plans a five-year capex outlay of Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 15,000 crore.
guidance.quote: comprehensive CAPEX plan for the next five years, with an estimated outlay of Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 15,000 crore

guidance.statement: GE has promised a supply of 12 engines in this calendar year.
guidance.quote: GE has promised a supply of 12 engines in this calendar year up to December.

guidance.statement: Order pipeline worth around Rs. 1 lakh crores is expected to materialize within two years.
guidance.quote: aggregate value of the order pipeline is estimated at around Rs. 1 lakh crores and are expected to materialize within the next one to two years.

guidance.statement: AL-31FP engines will be delivered at the rate of about 30 engines per annum.
guidance.quote: 240 engines, which we will be delivering at the rate of about 30 engines per annum.

achieved.claim: Turnover increased to Rs. 30,105 crores, achieving 7% growth over the previous year.
Achieved profit before tax of Rs. 10,820 crores, which is 35% of revenue.
Received new orders aggregating Rs. 1,25,280 crores during the financial year.
The order book improved to Rs. 1,89,300 crores after current year turnover liquidation.

pushback.concern: GE engine supply delays impacting LCA Mark 1 delivery schedule over next three years.
Reasons for significant delays and fundamental design changes in the LUH program.
Risk of MRO business declining as older platforms phase out amid manufacturing ramp-up.
Revenue growth guidance is only 8-10% despite a massive order book backlog.

output.tone_why: Management expressed confidence in robust profitability, strong order pipeline, and resolved supply chain issues.
